items.docs: List resource plugins under the specified Signadot org. By default returns only the highest-semver version of each plugin. Pass `?version=all` to expand the response into one row per published (name, version), sorted by name then semver-descending. `?version=latest` is accepted as an explicit alias for the default.

params.name: version
params.description: Resource plugin version (semver); omit for latest

items.docs: Get the specified resource plugin. Omit the version query parameter to get the latest version.

Creates a new version of a resource plugin. The body's `name` field carries the wire form `bareName[@semver]` (e.g. `my-plugin@1.2.0`); its bare part must match the URL path name. A bare-name form (no `@`) publishes the default version `0.0.0`. Versions are immutable; PUTting an existing (name, version) pair returns 409. The version suffix must be a concrete semver; "latest" is only accepted on the read and delete query parameters.
